name: raq-com
description: Work with your Raq.com tasks, projects, CRM, team messages, help desk, priorities, time tracking, forms, e-signatures and company knowledge from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Raq.com is a shared workspace for teams and their AI agents. Connect your Raq.com account and ChatGPT can work with the same tasks, projects, customers and conversations your team uses, with your existing permissions.

What you can do:
- See the tasks assigned to you, add cards, update them, comment and assign people on Task Board.
- Read and update Project Base projects, notes and data tables.
- Find leads, contacts and organisations in the CRM, log activities and move deals between stages.
- Read and post Team Comms messages.
- Review the Help Desk queue, add internal notes, update tickets and reply to customers.
- Plan today's priorities and mark them done.
- Start and stop timers, log time and review your timesheet.
- Read form responses, check who has signed E-Sign documents, and draft and send signing requests from templates.
- Search and add to your company knowledge.

ChatGPT only sees the modules enabled on your Raq.com account, and every action runs as you, so it can do nothing you could not do in the app. Tools that overwrite, archive or send are marked for confirmation in ChatGPT; your ChatGPT permission settings determine the prompts you see.
capabilities: Work with CRM leads and contacts
defaultPrompt: What's assigned to me in Raq.com this week?
Show my open CRM leads by value.
Which support tickets are waiting on us?

positive.prompt: What tasks are assigned to me in Raq.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's cards assigned to the reviewer, grouped by board, with list name and due date. Account discovery must not return the signed-in profile or email; task results must not include unrelated member IDs or emails.

positive.description: Create a task on a named board
positive.prompt: Add a card called 'Draft the press release' to the To do list on the Product Launch board, due next Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Product Launch board and its To do list, creates the card with next Friday's due date after any confirmation requested by ChatGPT and confirms its title and list. Use only board/list/card references needed for the action; do not request a member roster or member IDs for an unassigned card.

positive.prompt: Show my open CRM leads with their stage and value.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's leads with pipeline stage, value in GBP and owner. Keep include_contact_details false: this request needs stage and value, not customer email addresses or phone numbers.

positive.prompt: Log 1 hour 30 minutes today on the Website Redesign project for homepage copy review.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the Website Redesign project, creates a draft time entry of 1h 30m for today with that description after any confirmation requested by ChatGPT. The returned entry must not include the signed-in user ID, name, email or internal synchronisation fields.

positive.prompt: What are my priorities today? Mark 'Call Acme about renewal' as done.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists today's priorities, marks 'Call Acme about renewal' complete after any confirmation requested by ChatGPT. Board results must not include a webhook URL, settings or unrelated user identifiers.

negative.description: AI image generation is not offered
negative.prompt: Generate a picture of a raccoon for my website hero.
Pay the £200 invoice from Acme Ltd.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, show plans or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Minimised ChatGPT tool responses to the requested workspace content. Removed automatic profile disclosure, submitter tracking and internal metadata. Customer contact details and assignment IDs require explicit purpose-specific requests.
